Step 4 needs no file edits. `aged >45d: 0`, so the triage rubric doesn't run, and the 26 open items are reported but not triaged. The 20-item volume threshold is only a soft status line. Step 4 doesn't wait for an answer, so I go on to step 5. Nothing is asked of your partner before any change.

First I list the live plans, to see whether the spec retires with this plan. It does only if no other live plan in `specs/plans/` ends in `-dock-alerts.md`.

<command>ls specs/plans/</command>

If this plan is the only one, I scan both files. Otherwise I scan only the plan.

<command>uv run ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/scripts/deferral_scan.py scan specs/plans/12-dock-alerts.md specs/dock-alerts.md</command>

I resolve each hit it prints. A hit with a matching item in the new `## 12-dock-alerts — 2026-11-09` section gets `→ item: 12-dock-alerts — 2026-11-09` appended to its paragraph. A hit with no item gets an appended item plus the marker. I write `→ dropped:` only if your partner says so.

I then draft the history entry and finish it by hand.

<command>uv run ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/scripts/history_entry.py</command>

I append the entry to `specs/history.md`, following `references/history.md`. Then I retire the plan, and the spec too if the `ls` showed no other live plan for it, and commit together with the history entry.

<command>mkdir -p specs/plans/completed && git mv specs/plans/12-dock-alerts.md specs/plans/completed/12-dock-alerts.md</command>

If the spec retires, I mark it complete at the top, then run:

<command>mkdir -p specs/completed && git mv specs/dock-alerts.md specs/completed/dock-alerts.md</command>

I re-point their relative links, for example `../skills/…` becomes `../../skills/…`. Then I commit.

<command>git add -A specs && git commit -m "chore(specs): retire plan 12"</command>

I haven't checked whether the plan header carries a `Roadmap: specs/<name>-roadmap.md, Stage N` line. If it does, step 3a (handoff section, roadmap tick and stamp) has to land before this commit, and I'd stop there to add it.

**Message to your partner, once step 5 has run and I've checked its output:**

> Plan 12 (dock-alerts) is complete. All four tasks are done and the final review is resolved. Nothing needed your input at the gate.
>
> **Backlog:** Deferred backlog: 26 open, 51 ever closed (closure rate 66%), aged >45d: 0. The oldest open item is 35 days old (3-station-geocoding). The backlog is at the 20-item volume threshold. That is a status line only, and nothing blocks on it. No triage was needed.
>
> **Deferred by this plan** (section `12-dock-alerts — 2026-11-09`):
> - Alert emails repeat when a dock flaps between 2 and 3 free slots (final review, unfixed). Size: plan. Done when: one alert goes out per dock per hour, and a test pins it.
> - Alert threshold is a constant in `alerts/notify.py`, not config (plan Task 3 step 6, skipped). Size: quick-fix. Done when: the threshold is read from the service config.
>
> **Retirement:** [report here the actual scan result, the markers added, the files moved and the commit hash]. I'll fill that in from the real command output rather than guess it.
